def load_split(path: Path, max_examples: Optional[int] = None) -> List[ReactionExample]:
    examples: List[ReactionExample] = []
    n_seen = n_kept = 0
    with open(path, "r") as f:
        for i, line in enumerate(f):
            n_seen += 1
            ex = _parse_line(i, line)
            if ex is not None:
                examples.append(ex)
                n_kept += 1
                if max_examples is not None and n_kept >= max_examples:
                    break
    print(
        f"  loaded {n_kept}/{n_seen} examples from {path.name} "
        f"({100 * n_kept / max(n_seen, 1):.1f}% kept)"
    )
    return examples

concerns.title: Disclose BH whole-pool target normalization
concerns.summary: The released train-size ablation computes mean/std from all train_pool labels before fraction-specific TRAIN/VAL selection. That includes VAL labels and targets from rows excluded at small fractions. State this source-native condition explicitly; a train-only normalizer is a changed condition.

concerns.title: Disclose GST shared source learning rate versus paper per-model rates
concerns.summary: Paper3.1.2 assigns AdamW1e-3 to DS/ST and1e-4 to GST, while the cached synthetic, BH and USPTO configurations and runners apply one args.lr=0.001 to every model. The known discrepancy is omitted from v1.

concerns.title: Bind the published AP GNOMix comparison endpoint
concerns.summary: v1 describes six-path AP metrics and rejects four-source collapsing as a substitute, but neither main contract contains the original GNOMix comparator recipe. SupplementNote3p34 uses EHG/WHG/CHG/Ana references, GBR/BronzeAge/Neo/Yam queries, excludes BAA, uses five200Mbp sequences and evenly spaced sites, logistic-regression base+xgboost smoother,0.02cM GBR and0.2cM other cohorts.
